subject: Jenkins is still throwing std::bad_alloc exceptions

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Jenkins is still throwing std::bad_alloc exceptions
parts:
The failure on Windows now happens in the model tests.

I'll try to hunt this down, but any help is appreciated.

It only shows up in Windows when running in parallel. I'm having trouble reasoning whether it's a Windows only error or heap corruption somewhere else. I'm thinking this might be a problem since we were able to run the tests on that machine without this error.

Daniel

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Jenkins is still throwing std::bad_alloc exceptions
parts:
Any idea where the bad_alloc exceptions are coming from?

And is it just an out-of-memory problem? That is, does the memory
usage keep going up before the bad_alloc happens.

I was hoping we'd gotten rid of all the leaks. Only a few
functions got touched w.r.t. memory.

- Bob
